summary.title: Developing Games with React, Redux, and SVG - Part 1
summary.one_liner: You learn to bootstrap a React and Redux project and build SVG components (canvas, sky, ground, cannon) for a browser shooting game, "Aliens, Go Home!".
keywords: svg path commands m v h c
takeaways: Set up a React project with create-react-app, then add Redux, react-redux and prop-types.
Separate presentational components from container components, and connect state via a reducer and store.
Build an SVG canvas that fills the screen using viewBox and centers the origin.
Compose SVG elements (rect, line, circle, path) into React components such as sky, ground and cannon.
Understand the SVG coordinate system (Y axis inverted) and that draw order follows element order.
summary.summary: This first part of a series walks through creating a browser game called Aliens, Go Home! using create-react-app, Redux with react-redux, and PropTypes. It shows how to write a reducer, a presentational App component, and a Game container connected to the store. It then introduces SVG basics, including path commands and cubic Bezier curves, before building SVG React components: a full-screen canvas with a viewBox, a sky rect, and a ground made of a rect and line. The section ends as the author starts a cannon component using Bezier paths.
